question: {If } cottheta = (7)/(8), { then evaluate} (8(1 + sintheta)(1 - sintheta))/(7(1 + costheta)(1 - costheta)).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify the expression using the identity **(a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²** and **1 − sin²θ = cos²θ**, **1 − cos²θ = sin²θ**.

Expression = [8(1 − sin²θ)] / [7(1 − cos²θ)] = (8/7) × (cos²θ / sin²θ) = (8/7) × cot²θ.

Given **cotθ = 7/8**, so cot²θ = 49/64.

Result = (8/7) × (49/64) = 7/8.

**∴ The correct answer is 7/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** cotθ = 7/8

**Formula Used:** sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 ⇒ 1 − sin²θ = cos²θ and 1 − cos²θ = sin²θ; cotθ = cosθ/sinθ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/539d0f93037eccd8fb3882da93005ac5eccd7484d44b07343672c5d0df7cf6ab.png] 

⇒ Expression = [8(1 + sinθ)(1 − sinθ)] / [7(1 + cosθ)(1 − cosθ)]

⇒ Expression = [8(1 − sin²θ)] / [7(1 − cos²θ)]

⇒ Expression = (8/7) × (cos²θ / sin²θ)

⇒ Expression = (8/7) × cot²θ

⇒ Expression = (8/7) × (7/8)²

⇒ Expression = (8/7) × (49/64)

⇒ Expression = 7/8

**∴ The correct answer is 7/8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identities include **sin²θ + cos²θ = 1**, **1 + tan²θ = sec²θ**, and **1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ**.

Trigonometric Ratios

**cotθ** is the ratio of the adjacent side (Base) to the opposite side (Perpendicular) in a right-angled triangle, or **cosθ/sinθ**.

Algebraic Identities in Trig

Applying **(a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²** is a common shortcut to simplify numerator and denominator terms containing **1 ± sinθ** or **1 ± cosθ**.</p
